column1: # EXP-R2-225 Wave A, pure-text scale trajectory: stage-01 context-information
# qualification of Qwen2.5-7B on the eight frozen OpenWebText blocks.
# DISPATCH ONLY AFTER campaign_r225_qwen_interface.tsv RETURNS PASS for this arm.
# That gate is the campaign's all-or-stop prerequisite and stops this arm on failure;
# the queue's slot barrier orders cells but cannot make one conditional on another's
# verdict, so the two are separate dispatches on purpose.
# The eight blocks reproduce the panel cells qwen2.5-0.5b was qualified on, and that
# is measured rather than asserted: each expect basename carries the cohort digest
# recomputed on this workstation from the same corpus at the same draw, and all eight
# match the digests of the EXP-R2-216/221 artefacts byte for byte -- b0 78cbc340a2df
# through b7 3342aeb07562. A cell that drew anything else writes a differently named
# file and is reported no-artifact rather than silently paired against a block it does
# not share. Pool 1000, --cohort-skip 7000k for k = 0..7, n 200, character floor 800,
# held-out unigram reference 4000, --seed 20260727 -- the seed EXP-R2-225 binds the
# Qwen rungs to for comparability with qwen2.5-0.5b.
# --allow-second-stage-arms is this campaign's own door and admits only
# STAGED_SECOND_STAGE_ARMS. It is not --allow-staged-scale-arms and does not widen
# EXP-R2-224's first round; the two doors never admit each other's arms.
# --skip-truncation because budget.truncation_curve cannot compute a curve above a
# 1024-column live head on this transformers build and this arm emits 152064. That is
# panel_contract's own rule for every text arm, applied here by hand because a staged
# non-member is in no cohort-power bucket. The truncation curve is a reported
# diagnostic that 41_context_information_bootstrap.py never reads.
# --max-len 384 IS THE CAP, and it is written out rather than left to the default.
# Qwen2.5-7B declares max_position_embeddings 131072, three orders of magnitude above
# the 384-token window this estimand is measured in and above every protein arm's
# context. Nothing in stage 01 derives a length from the config -- max_len is an
# argument all the way down -- but the two fitness stages do derive one that way, so
# the bound is stated here where a reader can see it.
# Cards 1 and 2 only. Card 0 is left for the galactica-30b cell, whose checkpoint is
# staging while this runs; two cells per slot, all eight of one shape, so a slot
# barrier waits on like-shaped work and strands nothing.
# slot
